playerAnalytics.definitionNote: Database dates use Asia/Bangkok; Google Analytics dates use the property's timezone. Sent counts requests created in the selected period, not attempts. Unique people are deduplicated across sports within each request type; do not add the two columns or action audiences. Accepted does not confirm that people played together. No message text, names, contact details, or profile IDs are sent with these analytics events.
playerAnalytics.exclusionNote: Admin accounts and profile IDs listed as test accounts in the analytics exclusion configuration are excluded. Browser events are also disabled on localhost and preview domains. Test accounts cannot be identified automatically. Earlier browsing cannot be backfilled.
